newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rise, Mediterranean steady.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rise, Mediterranean steady.

text.p: ARA bunker prices rose on Thursday as higher priced December barge deliveries took effect, while the Med was steady, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST was rated at $122/$123 fob after barges gained $2 in the morning. Bunker enquiries totalled about 10-15,000 tonnes in the ARA area, but suppliers said a number of shipowners shied away from actual deals.
Hamburg also rose, but only by $1. However, the limited premium over Rotterdam encouraged little buying.
Mediterranean prices were largely steady and demand in almost all areas was slight.
Problems in France related to the lorry driver blockades continued.
"People are very nervous about making enquiries into France today. Strike problems are very big," one supplier said.
Fujairah bunkers were steady at $114/$115 fob with traders at stalemate in Singapore.
